offering_description.value: Markets and sells branded over-the-counter healthcare and household cleaning products to consumers. It owns the brands and outsources manufacturing to third-party contract manufacturers. Products are sold mainly through mass merchants, drug stores, grocery and online retailers.

primary_products.value: eye and ear care products; wound care and skin care products; cough, cold and allergy remedies; analgesics and gastrointestinal remedies; women's health and oral care products

customer_segment.value: B2B: Retailers such as mass merchants, drug stores, grocery chains, club stores and wholesalers; B2C: Consumers purchasing OTC health and household products

end_markets.value: consumer healthcare; over-the-counter medicines; household cleaning; retail

revenue_model.value: product sales: branded OTC healthcare and household cleaning products sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: owns and markets OTC brands made by third-party contract manufacturers, sold to retailers

geography_served.value: global: Primarily United States, plus Canada, Australia, Europe and other international markets

specialization.value: related lines: Several OTC healthcare categories plus a small household cleaning line sharing retail channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, drug stores, grocery, club and dollar stores; distributors / dealers: wholesalers and international distributors; online: e-commerce retailers and marketplaces

regulatory_exposure.value: high: OTC drugs and medical devices regulated by FDA, including monograph rules and manufacturing practice requirements, similar foreign regulators
